sources.title: Kav's ELT Games Sharks!をオンラインで購入
sources.snippet: SHARKS！は、楽しいカードと役立つ問題が満載の初心者向けゲームです。 Sharks!ではプレーヤーが順番に面白いカードを引いて、基本の英語の質問と回答のパターンを学べ

sources.title: Online ESL Games
sources.snippet:
Read the sentences and move the clothes. Reveal the images and click on the words.

Click the words to practice making phrasal verbs. Listen to the numbers and move the monster.

Practice present simple tense verbs. Look at the images and make comparatives.

  
  

Learn or practice basic similes. Listen and click on the correct food images.

Practice making sentences in perfect tense. Click and drag the words to match the images. [...] Speaking practice. Say the vocab items. Speaking practice. Say the phrases.

Practice vocabulary and phrases for daily activities. Practice future tense sentences with 'Going To'.

Move the clouds to make sentences. Find the matching pairs of images and words.

Listen and move the weather images to the countries. Guess the animal by forming questions.

A fun ESL game for Halloween. A fun ESL game for Christmas.

Practice days of the week in English. Practice vocab for family members. [...] Click on the words and make questions. Interactive clock to practice telling the time.

Describe the images by making sentences. Find the words to match the images. Practice spelling.

Practice the 12 months of the year in English. Look at the image and then spell the word.

Guess the word or phrase as the image is revealed. Make conditional phrases to match the images.

  
  

Read the description and click on the matching image. A fun quiz to practice simple English.
